correctness.rationale: Local quotient multiplicativity and valuation cylinders are exact. The certificate computes integer bin boundaries checked on both sides with rational powers, and convolves all residue classes modulo the product of p^E. It verifies the exact proportion >216/1000. The bound log(prefix)<-1/100 follows from -41 log(1+1/4000). The exponential moment for divisibility indicators is bounded by expanding nonnegative products and using floor(X/d)<=X/d; no independence over n<=X is assumed. The rational series proves F(1400/503)<7, and a finite Taylor sum proves e^7>1000. The uniform tail loss is <1/1000. Hence reverse-comparison lower density >43/200 and the claimed delta<157/200. No finite-experiment-to-infinity step is unproved.

value.rationale: Trudgian explicitly posed the natural density problem and reported approximately 0.778307 from 10^9 data. A rigorous global ceiling of 0.785, coupled with an existing >0.770292 lower bound, localizes the unknown density to a width below 0.015, replacing the trivial upper bound 1 with a value close to the observed density. The result controls arbitrarily large prime factors by a uniform bound rather than extrapolation and directly advances an archived quantitative question; it is not an arbitrary unmotivated slice.
